constructor_signature: GroupedQueryAttention(num_query_heads: int = 15, num_key_value_heads: int = 5, head_dim: int = 64) -> None
forward_signature: forward(self, query: torch.Tensor, key: torch.Tensor, value: torch.Tensor, *, is_causal: bool = True) -> torch.Tensor
group_mapping: Each contiguous group of query_heads / key_value_heads query heads maps to the corresponding key/value head; with 15/5, heads 0-2 map to KV 0, heads 3-5 map to KV 1, and so on.

causal_semantics.unequal_lengths: For query_length <= key_length, query index i maps to key position key_length - query_length + i.

dtype_device.accumulation: float64 for float64 input; float32 otherwise

performance: Uses grouped contractions without explicit KV tensor replication; not a specialized fused GQA kernel.
